title: Solder project
description: A project (DT-099): LabVIEW's .lvproj copied one to one in JSON. One item tree under the target My Computer: the user's items (folders first, then the rest, each by name), then Dependencies and Build Specifications. Normative: a .sdproj file that does not validate against this schema is not conformant. Read and written by core/model/project.mjs.

solder-project.description: The version of the format. A reader MUST refuse a version newer than the one it knows.

window.description: Where the Project Explorer window was when the project was saved (DT-099 §4), in pixels; without it the window opens as a new project's.

items.description: The project's targets; for now only My Computer (DT-099 §5).

comment.description: The user's comment (DT-100 §6): any object may hold one. Readers give it no meaning, the compiler never reads it, and writers keep it on its object.

name.description: The item's name in the tree.

kind.description: LabVIEW's item type in Solder's words (DT-099 §2): the target, an OVI (LabVIEW's VI, which also covers controls and polymorphic OVIs), any other file, a folder, and the two fixed items.

path.description: The file or the mirrored folder, relative to the .sdproj's folder (absolute on another disk), or `<ovilib>/…`.

auto-populating.description: A folder that mirrors the folder at `path` (LabVIEW's Folder (Auto-populating)); its contents are not written.

items.description: What a target or a virtual folder holds. Dependencies is never written with contents.
